description: Linear GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK for issues, projects and agents, with OAuth and webhooks.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and user or app actor modes. Personal API keys are not covered by the sources.
gate_detail: Linear has a free plan plus paid plans; OAuth applications are created by workspace admins, and creating a dedicated workspace for the OAuth app is recommended. Free-plan API limits are not stated.
api_scope: GraphQL API with pagination, filtering, webhooks, attachments and customers, plus a TypeScript SDK and agent interaction docs.
mcp_notes: Linear hosts a remote MCP server for reading and changing issues, projects and documents.
blocker_detail: None stated; OAuth apps are managed by workspace admins.

evidence.quote: Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you’re building applications to integrate with Linear.
We offer a free plan and different paid plans to suit your needs.
connect to the Linear MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp to read and change issues, projects, and documents.

uncertainties: Personal API key support is not shown in the sources.
Source S3 is a third-party Linear Canal product, not Linear.
No sandbox described; free-plan API access not explicitly stated.
